capabilities: Replaces new tabs with a start page
Shows vault statistics and an edit heatmap
Lists pinned and recently modified notes
Opens a fuzzy search modal from the homepage
Creates notes from a title template and target folder
extras: Interface is available in Chinese and English; settings are backed up automatically once a day, and the plugin can check GitHub for new releases.
problem: Obsidian opens to an empty tab or the last note, so there is no overview of recent work, important notes or vault activity at startup.

relations.evidence: Import from Bookmarks: Easily import pinned notes from Obsidian's built-in bookmarks feature

summary: Startup homepage dashboard showing vault statistics, pinned notes and recently modified notes, with quick search and note creation.
